title: HtmlRt
responsibility: Renders the native rt element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlRt.attributes
inputs.description: Native rt attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlRt.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native rt element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlRt
outputs.description: The actual native rt element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
